title: Fully integrated perovskite active polaritonic circuits
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11299-5

A fully integrated perovskite polaritonic circuit that brings the functionalities of fully integrated on-chip polaritonic systems simultaneously delivering room-temperature waveguide lasing, controllable optical routing and amplification together in a single-step-grown platform is shown.
